title: PIXL 8000 Cherry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Sour Raspberry PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod blends juicy Cherry with a bold, tart Raspberry edge for a perfectly judged sweet-and-sour vape. The balance of fruit tones creates a bright, mouthwatering flavour that stays clear and satisfying from the first puff to the last. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for smooth satisfaction and consistent flavour delivery. Designed for the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, every pod connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically refills as you vape—providing up to 8000 puffs per kit without manual refilling. Mesh coil technology ensures precise flavour definition and reliable vapour production with a clean MTL draw ideal for everyday use.
